patterns.note: A minimalist, single-column layout with generous vertical spacing emphasizes typography and creates an airy, uncluttered feel.

A strong typographic hierarchy uses a very large, bold sans-serif for primary headings, a lighter sans-serif for body text, and small, uppercase labels for metadata, creating clear visual distinction.

The primary color scheme is a high-contrast monochromatic base (white/dark grey and dark grey/light grey) which dynamically inverts, punctuated by a vibrant, warm accent palette (orange, light pink) within a specific, immersive section.

A full-page, scroll-triggered background and text color inversion (light to dark, then dark to light) acts as a primary visual transition between major content blocks, dynamically changing the site's theme.
A complex, animated, three-dimensional-like grid of graphic elements is revealed and then hidden as a user scrolls through a specific section, creating an immersive, interactive experience.
Major content sections are delineated by large, bold headings and subtle horizontal rules, rather than distinct background blocks or containers, maintaining a minimalist aesthetic.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered theme switch, where the entire page's background and text colors invert (from light to dark, then back to light) at specific scroll depths, creating a dynamic visual flow using css-keyframes.

A highly interactive, three-dimensional-like graphic section is revealed and animated using webgl-three, where abstract design elements in a distinct color palette appear to float and rotate in a grid as the user scrolls, creating an immersive portfolio showcase.
The navigation bar remains sticky at the top, dynamically adapting its background and text colors to match the current page theme (light or dark) as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with a generous line height, contrasted with smaller, lighter sans-serif body text and tiny, uppercase metadata labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and open, particularly in the hero and between major text blocks, creating a sense of calm and focus on typography.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-page, scroll-triggered background and text color inversion, combined with an immersive, animated 3D-like graphic section, creates a highly dynamic and memorable portfolio experience that transcends a typical static layout.
